videos.title: A Man Turned a Boeing 727 into a Luxury Mansion
videos.author: BRIGHT SIDE
videos.description:
Forget cozy houses and modern apartments. One man decided to live inside a Boeing 727 instead. He bought the retired plane and turned it into a fully livable home, complete with bedrooms, a kitchen, and a lounge. It sounds like something from a movie, but for him, it's just everyday life.
